answer: Stop sybils with a vault signal beacon: an agent bonds one vault. Each cycle it fires one signal from vault to beacon; verifiers match the signal's cooling curve on the beacon lens to the vault chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 vaults at 19x: one signal cools once in one vault, its curve set by that vault alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents fire once, keep rights.
